metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform owned and operated by our company." {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity."

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization, through which card authorisations are routed." "External"
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization, through which credit checks are performed." "External"

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform owned and operated by our company, through which customers manage accounts, move money, and track activity." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts." "Web application" "Web"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app." "API service"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records." "Service"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers." "Service"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers." "Service"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards." "Service"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts." "Service"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers." "Service"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements." "Service"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits." "Service"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation." "Batch job"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts." "Message queue" "Queue"
            ledgerDb = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement." "Database" "Database"
            customerDb = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records." "Database" "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database" "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data." "In-memory cache" "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs." "Document store" "Database"

            customer -> webPortal "Logs in and manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity" "HTTPS/JSON"
            customer -> mobileAppBackend "Uses the bank's mobile app to manage accounts, move money, and track activity" "HTTPS/JSON"

            webPortal -> accountService "Manages accounts" "HTTPS/JSON"
            webPortal -> transactionService "Moves money" "HTTPS/JSON"
            webPortal -> paymentService "Makes payments" "HTTPS/JSON"
            webPortal -> cardService "Manages cards" "HTTPS/JSON"
            webPortal -> statementsService "Views statements" "HTTPS/JSON"
            webPortal -> directDebitService "Manages standing orders and direct debits" "HTTPS/JSON"

            mobileAppBackend -> accountService "Manages accounts" "HTTPS/JSON"
            mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "Moves money" "HTTPS/JSON"
            mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "Makes payments" "HTTPS/JSON"
            mobileAppBackend -> cardService "Manages cards" "HTTPS/JSON"
            mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "Views statements" "HTTPS/JSON"
            mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "Manages standing orders and direct debits" "HTTPS/JSON"

            transactionService -> ledgerDb "Updates the ledger" "SQL"
            transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "Scores transactions for fraud" "HTTPS/JSON"
            transactionService -> eventQueue "Publishes events" "AMQP" "Async"

            notificationService -> eventQueue "Consumes events" "AMQP" "Async"
            statementsService -> ledgerDb "Reads account movements" "SQL"
            statementsService -> documentStore "Writes statement PDFs" "S3"
            batchScheduler -> ledgerDb "Reads and writes account movements" "SQL"
            batchScheduler -> customerDb "Reads and writes account and profile records" "SQL"

            paymentService -> cardService "Manages debit and credit cards" "HTTPS/JSON"
            paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "Gets currency conversion rates" "HTTPS/JSON"
            onboardingService -> customerDb "Reads account and profile records" "SQL"

            paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "Routes card authorisations" "HTTPS/JSON"
            onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "Performs credit checks" "HTTPS/JSON"
        }
    }

    views {

        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "Who uses the Bank Portal and what other systems it talks to." {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - System Context"
        }

        container bankPortal "FrontOffice" "How customers use the platform to manage accounts, move money, and make payments." {
            include customer
            include webPortal
            include mobileAppBackend
            include accountService
            include transactionService
            include paymentService
            include cardService
            include statementsService
            include directDebitService
            include exchangeRatesService
            include cardPaymentNetwork
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - Front Office"
        }

        container bankPortal "RiskCompliance" "How the platform detects fraud and verifies new customers." {
            include transactionService
            include fraudDetectionService
            include onboardingService
            include creditReferenceAgency
            include customerDb
            include auditDb
            include eventQueue
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - Risk and Compliance"
        }

        container bankPortal "DataAndBatch" "How data is stored and how batch and event-driven processes work." {
            include ledgerDb
            include customerDb
            include cache
            include documentStore
            include eventQueue
            include batchScheduler
            include statementsService
            include notificationService
            include transactionService
            autoLayout
            title "Bank Portal - Data and Batch"
        }

        styles {
            element "Person" {
                shape Person
                background #08427B
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Software System" {
                background #1168BD
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "External" {
                background #999999
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Container" {
                background #438DD5
                color #ffffff
            }
            element "Database" {
                shape Cylinder
            }
            element "Web" {
                shape WebBrowser
            }
            element "Queue" {
                shape Pipe
            }
            relationship "Async" {
                style dashed
            }
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
